correctness.rationale: The source equation is reconstructed exactly. The proof reduces positive-root counting to the horizontal intersections of \(q(s)=c_1s+(s-1)/s^k\). Its derivative has numerator \(H(s)=c_1s^{k+1}-(k-1)s+k\), which is strictly convex. The exact minimum of \(H\) gives the sharp cusp threshold; two derivative zeros below threshold give the two folds and all root counts. Direct differentiation proves exact triple multiplicity at the cusp. No finite experiment is used as proof.
